objective: Improve ISAForge iCE40 LUT4 area prediction and hardware-budget decisions: reduce false acceptances and repair remaining false rejections while preserving accuracy, subgroup performance, and previously validated corrections; demonstrate all required gains on fresh circuits.
authority: Current working clarification requested by the user. Supplements, never replaces or relaxes, boundary-repair-goal.json, boundary-repair-goal-update.json, or frozen experiment requirements.

latest_evidence.conclusion: Neither candidate passes. Integrity and publication audits pass; scientific completion gates fail.

next_step.status: hypothesis only; not implemented or validated
next_step.proposal: Compare direct multioutput budget-feasibility classifiers using the same 1889 training rows and matched 217 versus 233 features.
next_step.prerequisite: Freeze a complete new protocol and expanded retained-case inventory before fits; freeze models, fresh predictions and selection before fresh synthesis labels.

completion_requirements: Pass every existing frozen completion gate; do not replace full-panel results with a favorable subset.
Preserve all 43 established required acceptances, all protected rejections, and additional truth-confirmed corrections from the latest experiment; inventory these explicitly before execution.

Report false acceptances and false rejections separately at 32, 64 and 128 LUT4, with feasible/infeasible denominators. No newly introduced budget mistakes or offsetting one mistake type with another.

Improve fresh-general MAE and positive-target MAPE against the signed reference while preserving budget-release gains and all required comparator, subgroup and tail-error gates. State zero-target handling.
Use genuinely fresh circuits and preserve all consumed labelled and unlabelled inputs as excluded novelty evidence. Keep evaluation labels out of training.

Require the predeclared activity coverage: at least four new acceptance corrections across two templates including cap128, one legacy cap64 veto and one sharing cap128 veto; no post-label refill or threshold adjustment.
Independently audit training membership, chronological freezes, saved inference, native synthesis and RTL correctness. Preserve failed experiments and publish reproducible results.
Promote a candidate or complete the goal only after every gate passes. Claims concern isolated iCE40 LUT4 circuits, not demonstrated CPU speedup, power improvement or universal safety.
stopping_rule: At each bounded experiment limit, record the outcome without extending the pool or weakening gates. A failed experiment leaves the goal active and requires a separately preregistered revision.
app_goal_limitation: The app goal remains active. Available goal tools permit status changes but not editing an existing objective; this file records the clarified operational objective without falsely completing or replacing it.
